description: Execute a canonical project build verb in the plan's worktree (or primary checkout when plan_id is NO_PLAN) via the integrated build runner.

plan_id.description: Plan scope whose worktree the build runs in. The literal NO_PLAN runs in the primary repository checkout as a workspace-addressed request; its ledger row, findings, and log belong to the workspace scope.

command.description: Canonical build verb (job-runtime.adoc, Canonical Build Verb Set) resolved against the project's enrolled or compiled default template and enrolled wrapper.

module.description: Optional logical module identifier discovered in the project (never an arbitrary filesystem path); absent means a whole-tree run, present means that module only (gate scope follows from this argument, never from the verb); a module the project's discovery does not know is refused with invalid_arguments.

test_filter.description: Optional test class or method filter when command is 'module-tests' or 'integration-tests'.

expect.description: Declared intent of the run; 'red' marks a deliberately failing run (for example a test written before its fix).

job_id.description: Optional job_id of a running build returned earlier by pm_build; the call then continues waiting on that build for one bounded window (PM-TOOL-2, PM-IMPL-4) instead of starting a new one; a job_id of a finished build of the same scope returns that build's terminal result; an unknown job_id, or one of another scope, is refused with invalid_arguments.
